subject: maths
source: CISCE Curriculum for Primary Classes I-V (2016), official

covers: Read and write numbers up to 999 and say their names
Use place value of hundreds, tens and ones to read, write and compare numbers
Arrange numbers in ascending and descending order
Find the greatest and smallest two-digit and three-digit numbers from given digits
Find the place value and face value of digits in a three-digit number
Show amounts up to 100 rupees with a few notes and coins
Add and subtract two-digit numbers, with and without regrouping, using place value
Know that adding or subtracting zero leaves the number unchanged
Notice that addition can be done in any order, through patterns
Solve and make up problems that need two-digit addition or subtraction
Estimate a sum or difference before working it out
Build multiplication tables of 2, 3, 4 and 5 through repeated addition and skip counting
Share and group objects equally, which leads to repeated subtraction
Add and subtract two-digit numbers in their head
Describe 2D and 3D shapes by what can be seen and felt
Name cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere, and rectangle, square, triangle and circle
Trace the 2D outlines of 3D objects
Tell straight lines from curved lines
Draw straight lines that are vertical, horizontal or slanting
Make 2D shapes by folding and cutting paper, and count their sides and corners
Measure length and distance using uniform units such as a pencil or a paper clip
Measure how much a container holds using cups, spoons or buckets
Compare objects by weight, using a simple balance
Name the days of the week and the months of the year
Put events that take hours or days in order
Read simple charts and graphs from daily life, such as a bus timetable
Show information as a pictograph
Collect and tally data in groups
Draw simple conclusions from what the data shows
Find the unit that repeats in a given pattern
Extend patterns using the repeating unit
Make their own patterns with shapes, objects and numbers

gaps: Teaching processes and learning resources are left out; the file lists only what a child learns.
